Out.longComment: Beck has yet to resume practicing and will miss a second consecutive game Sunday due to back spasms, paving the way for Josh Johnson to start against Washington. Suspension.longComment: Head coach Sean Payton had previously announced Tuesday that Dobbins would be suspended for Friday's game against the Steelers due to conduct detrimental to the team, but it wasn't immediately clear whether or not the running back would count toward the 53-man roster. As a result of Wednesday's transaction, the Broncos will now have an open roster spot to use for Week 12, and Tyler Badie (thumb) could be activated from injured reserve to help fill the void in the backfield. Dobbins' suspension came after he played just one snap in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders on Sunday, when rookie Jonah Coleman took on a bell-cow role and handled 28 touches.

feed.headline: The knee injury that Loveland sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions is expected to land him on IR, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
feed.description: The knee injury that Loveland sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions is expected to land him on IR, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
feed.story: If that's the case, Loveland would need to miss at least four games, with Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network noting Friday that a knee sprain is the initial diagnosis for Loveland. In that scenario, a late-season return could be in the cards for him. In Loveland's anticipated absence, Sam Roush is in line to see added snaps and targets, a context that could yield fantasy relevance down the stretch for the 2026 third-rounder.

feed.headline: Loveland (knee) is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Friday on the knee injury he sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.
feed.description: Loveland (knee) is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Friday on the knee injury he sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.
feed.story: The Bears are hoping the results of Friday's MRI reveal a sprain rather than a tear, as the former outcome could lead to a relatively swift recovery, while the latter scenario could result in Loveland missing the rest of the season. Loveland got hurt in the first half of Thursday's comeback win. Prior to the injury, Loveland caught his only target for five yards but fumbled at the end of that play.

feed.headline: Loveland (knee) has been ruled out from returning to Thursday's game in Detroit.
feed.description: Loveland (knee) has been ruled out from returning to Thursday's game in Detroit.
feed.story: After Loveland was rolled up on in the middle of the first quarter, he was favoring his left knee as made his way to the sideline, where he visited the sideline tent before being carted to the locker room. Now that he officially won't return to this Week 12 contest, rookie third-round pick Sam Roush and veteran Stephen Carlson are the team's healthy and available tight ends.

feed.headline: Loveland (undisclosed) went to the medical tent during Thursday's game at Detroit, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.
feed.description: Loveland (undisclosed) went to the medical tent during Thursday's game at Detroit, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.
feed.story: Loveland limped off the field in the middle of the first quarter and immediately went to the sideline tent. The nature of his injury isn't known, but he had one catch (on one target) for five yards and lost a fumble prior to his exit.
